summary: This directory centralizes the data contracts and type definitions for AI-driven conversations, establishing a formal structure for messages, attachments, and the request-response payloads required for communication between the client and an AI service.
responsibilities: Define schemas for AI chat requests and responses
Model the structure of message entities and their associated metadata
Specify the format for message attachments
Standardize participant roles within a conversation
relationships: A chat request contains a history of messages and a current message input.
A chat response wraps a single message entity within a standard result structure.
Messages can include multiple attachments and utilize specific roles to define participant behavior.
designDecisions: Use of schema-based validation to infer types
Centralized export strategy for domain models
Strict separation of request and response payloads
